description: Views a pull request by number, URL, or branch. Returns structured data with state, checks, review decision, diff stats, author, labels, draft status, assignees, milestone, and timestamps. The `body` is capped at 4000 characters (HTML <details> blocks collapsed to their <summary> first) and flagged with `bodyTruncated`/`bodyLength`; raise or lift the cap with `maxBodyLength` (0 = verbatim).

maxBodyLength.description: Maximum characters kept in the returned body (default 4000). Before capping, HTML <details> blocks are collapsed to their <summary> text. Set to 0 to disable both and return the body verbatim.

number.description: Pull request number, URL, or branch name

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

repo.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO format (--repo). Default: current repo.

name: pr-view
title: PR View
